🎯 Lesson Objectives
أهداف الدرس — What you will learn
  • 1
    Talk about household chores and complaints using the Present Perfect.
    التحدث عن المهام المنزلية والشكاوى باستخدام المضارع التام.
  • 2
    Use Have you … yet? / Yes, I've already done it. to ask and answer about tasks.
    استخدام أسئلة المضارع التام مع yet و already.
  • 3
    Recognize and discuss common complaints in families.
    التعرف على الشكاوى الشائعة في الأسر والتحدث عنها.

    Listen to a dialogue about sharing and responsibility.

  • 5
    Make polite requests using Please + verb.
    استخدام الطلب المؤدب بصيغة Please + فعل.

📖 Grammar Focus
شرح القاعدة — Present Perfect with yet / already / just
✦ Asking about tasks: Have you … yet?
Use Have / Has + subject + past participle + yet?
👉 Have you cleaned up your room yet?
👉 Have you done the dishes yet?
نستخدم yet في نهاية السؤال لنسأل إذا كان العمل قد انتهى أم لا.
✦ Positive answer: already
Use Yes, I've already + past participle.
👉 Yes, I've already done it.
👉 Yes, I've just given them some food.
already = أنجزت الأمر قبل أن تسأل.  |  just = أنجزته للتو.
✦ Negative answer: yet
Use No, I haven't + past participle + yet.
👉 No, I haven't done it yet.
yet في النفي = لم أنته من العمل بعد.
🙏 Polite Requests — الطلب المؤدب

Use Please + verb to make a polite request:

👉 Please stop playing that game.

👉 Please put away my hair dryer after you use it.

نستخدم Please + فعل أمر للطلب بأسلوب مؤدب.

😤 Common Complaints in Families
الشكاوى الشائعة في الأسر — from the textbook
📋 Many families list the same complaints. Here are some common ones:
  • Leaving dirty clothes and shoes all around the house
  • Using someone else's hairbrush
  • Splashing toothpaste all over the bathroom mirror
  • Borrowing things and not asking first
  • Not cleaning your room
  • Spending a lot of time in the bathroom
  • Playing the TV or video games very loudly
💡 I can't stand …

Use I can't stand + verb-ing to express that something bothers you:

👉 I can't stand listening to it anymore.

👉 I can't stand people eating while they're using the computer.

"I can't stand" = لا أطيق / لا أتحمل + فعل مضاف له -ing

📌 Lesson Summary
ملخص الدرس — What we learned today
  • ✅
    Have you … yet? is used to ask if a task is complete.
    نستخدمها للسؤال عن إنجاز مهمة ما.
  • ✅
    Yes, I've already done it. — confirms the task is finished.
    already تعني أن العمل انتهى قبل السؤال.
  • ✅
    Yes, I've just … — the task was done very recently.
    just تعني أنجزته للتو.
  • ✅
    No, I haven't … yet. — the task is not done.
    yet في الجواب السلبي تعني "بعد".
  • ✅
    Please + verb for polite requests.
    الطلب المؤدب = Please + فعل.
  • ✅
    I can't stand + verb-ing to express dislike or annoyance.
    لا أطيق / لا أتحمل + فعل مضاف له -ing.
  • ✅
    Common family complaints: borrowing without asking, not cleaning rooms, playing games loudly.
    الشكاوى الأسرية الشائعة.

💡 Pair Work Reminder

A. Ask and answer about household chores:

Ask 🗣️Have you taken the garbage out yet?
Answer 💬Yes, I've already done it.
— OR —
No, I haven't done it yet.

B. Make requests about sharing:

Request 🗣️Please stop using my hair dryer.
Response 💬Don't you remember? You lent it to me.

C. Talk about things you can't stand:

Ask 🗣️What do people do around the house that you don't like?
Answer 💬I can't stand people eating while they're using the computer.
